title: OpenAI Secures $110 Billion in Historic Funding Round — 2026-03-02
description: OpenAI has completed a monumental $110 billion funding round, one of the largest in tech history. With major contributions from Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank, this investment marks a significant milestone for the AI sector.
